title: See What I Need, Dream What I Want: A Navigation Foundation Model on a Self-Constructed Representation Space
description:
arXiv:2610.31762v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: What visual representation should a navigation policy act on? Navigation policies built on vision foundation models largely leave representation design to the encoders' pretraining objectives. We present RepresentNav, a navigation foundation model built on a self-constructed representation space: a visual representation constructed by the policy's own objectives from vision foundation models.
